purpose: Verify patient views static weekly schedule together with live attendance status
preconditions: Doctor schedule is published and attendance recorded for today
action_or_input: Patient requests doctor availability view
expected_result: Weekly schedule and today live attendance status are returned

purpose: Verify patient views own medical history and prescriptions read-only
preconditions: Patient has recorded visits and prescriptions
action_or_input: Patient opens my medical records
expected_result: Patient visit history and prescriptions displayed in read-only form

purpose: Verify access is denied when patient attempts to view another patient records
preconditions: Patient A and Patient B exist with separate records
action_or_input: Patient A attempts to access Patient B visit record by id
expected_result: Access is denied with UnauthorizedRecordAccessError or 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify patient downloads PDF copy of own medical records
preconditions: Selected records belong to authenticated patient
action_or_input: Patient requests PDF download
expected_result: A downloadable PDF document containing patient records is returned

purpose: Verify eligible employee applies for medical bill reimbursement successfully
preconditions: Employee has valid linked prescription and expense date within window
action_or_input: Employee submits complete reimbursement application
expected_result: Claim is created in Pending PHC Review state with action history

purpose: Verify reimbursement submission denied when user is not an employee (e.g. student)
preconditions: User is authenticated as student
action_or_input: Student submits reimbursement claim
expected_result: Submission denied with IneligibleClaimantError

purpose: Verify reimbursement submission denied when prescription is missing or not owned by claimant
preconditions: Employee references invalid or another patient prescription
action_or_input: Employee attempts to submit claim
expected_result: Submission denied with PrescriptionRequiredError

purpose: Verify reimbursement submission denied when expense date is outside submission window
preconditions: Expense date is older than 90 days
action_or_input: Employee attempts to submit claim
expected_result: Submission denied with SubmissionWindowExpiredError

purpose: Verify employee tracks status and action history of own reimbursement claims
preconditions: Employee has submitted claims with progress history
action_or_input: Employee views claim tracking
expected_result: Current stage and progression history displayed for claimant claims only

purpose: Verify PHC Staff records patient visit and digitizes prescription
preconditions: Patient profile exists; user is PHC Staff
action_or_input: PHC Staff records consultation and digitized prescription
expected_result: Visit and prescription persisted and linked to patient

purpose: Verify PHC Staff maintains doctor master schedule
preconditions: Doctor schedule exists; user is PHC Staff
action_or_input: PHC Staff updates visiting day, room, and timings
expected_result: Schedule updated and saved with new parameters

purpose: Verify PHC Staff marks doctor real-time attendance
preconditions: Doctor exists; user is PHC Staff
action_or_input: PHC Staff marks status as Available or Departed
expected_result: Attendance record updated for current date

purpose: Verify stock deduction below threshold triggers low-stock alert
preconditions: Item exists with stock above threshold
action_or_input: PHC Staff deducts stock resulting in level below reorder threshold
expected_result: Stock level updated and low-stock warning notification created

purpose: Verify stock adjustment resulting in level at or above threshold generates no alert
preconditions: Item exists with stock above threshold
action_or_input: PHC Staff adjusts stock keeping level at or above threshold
expected_result: Stock level updated; no low-stock alert generated

purpose: Verify stock adjustment rejecting deduction exceeding available stock
preconditions: Item stock is less than deduction quantity
action_or_input: PHC Staff attempts to deduct more than current stock
expected_result: Adjustment rejected with InsufficientStockError; stock unchanged

purpose: Verify PHC Staff submits inventory procurement requisition
preconditions: Items and quantities specified; user is PHC Staff
action_or_input: PHC Staff creates and submits procurement requisition
expected_result: Requisition saved in Pending Approval state and routed

purpose: Verify PHC Staff logs ambulance usage with required details
preconditions: User is PHC Staff
action_or_input: Staff logs ambulance trip with patient name, destination, driver, departure time
expected_result: Ambulance usage entry created and persisted

purpose: Verify ambulance log rejected when required field is missing
preconditions: User is PHC Staff
action_or_input: Staff submits ambulance log with missing required destination
expected_result: Submission rejected by API validation (HTTP 400)

purpose: Verify PHC Staff broadcasts health announcements to patients
preconditions: User is PHC Staff
action_or_input: Staff publishes advisory with title, content, priority
expected_result: Announcement is active and retrievable by patients

purpose: Verify PHC Staff generates anonymized administrative reports
preconditions: PHC records exist; user is PHC Staff
action_or_input: Staff requests demographics, utilization, or inventory report
expected_result: Aggregated report generated without patient-identifiable data

purpose: Verify report generation with invalid report type parameter is rejected
preconditions: User is PHC Staff
action_or_input: Staff requests report with invalid type unsupported_type
expected_result: System raises ValueError or returns 400 Bad Request

purpose: Verify PHC Staff marks approved requisition as Fulfilled after delivery
preconditions: Requisition is in Approved state; user is PHC Staff
action_or_input: Staff records delivery fulfillment
expected_result: Requisition status set to Fulfilled; stock quantities not auto-altered

purpose: Verify marking requisition Fulfilled is blocked when requisition is not Approved
preconditions: Requisition is in Pending Approval or Rejected state
action_or_input: Staff attempts to fulfill non-approved requisition
expected_result: Fulfillment blocked with RequisitionNotApprovedError

purpose: Verify PHC Staff reviews submitted claim and forwards to Accounts
preconditions: Claim is in Pending PHC Review state
action_or_input: PHC Staff records review forward action
expected_result: Claim advances to Pending Accounts Verification

purpose: Verify Approving Authority approves pending inventory requisition
preconditions: Requisition is Pending Approval; user is Approving Authority
action_or_input: Approver approves requisition
expected_result: Requisition status becomes Approved and originator notified

purpose: Verify Approving Authority rejects pending inventory requisition
preconditions: Requisition is Pending Approval; user is Approving Authority
action_or_input: Approver rejects requisition
expected_result: Requisition status becomes Rejected and workflow terminates

purpose: Verify duplicate decision blocked when requisition is no longer Pending Approval
preconditions: Requisition is already Approved or Rejected
action_or_input: Approver attempts second decision
expected_result: Second decision blocked with InvalidStateTransitionError

purpose: Verify Accounts & Audit verifies financial details of reimbursement claim
preconditions: Claim is Pending Accounts Verification
action_or_input: Accounts staff records verification and forwards for sanction
expected_result: Claim advances to Pending Sanction

purpose: Verify Approving Authority approves reimbursement sanction
preconditions: Claim is Pending Sanction; user is Approving Authority
action_or_input: Approver approves sanction
expected_result: Claim status becomes Approved for Payment and claimant notified

purpose: Verify Approving Authority rejects reimbursement sanction terminating the claim
preconditions: Claim is Pending Sanction; user is Approving Authority
action_or_input: Approver rejects sanction
expected_result: Claim status becomes Rejected and claim cannot be reopened

purpose: Verify duplicate sanction decision blocked when claim is no longer Pending Sanction
preconditions: Claim is already Approved for Payment or Rejected
action_or_input: Approver attempts second sanction decision
expected_result: Duplicate decision blocked with InvalidStateTransitionError

purpose: Verify Accounts & Audit processes reimbursement payment closing claim
preconditions: Claim is Approved for Payment
action_or_input: Accounts records payment reference and completion
expected_result: Claim status becomes Reimbursed and claimant notified

purpose: Verify PHC Staff creates and publishes doctor schedule
preconditions: User is PHC Staff
action_or_input: Staff creates schedule and marks published
expected_result: Schedule is saved with is_published=True and visible to patients
